items.title: Four equivalent conditions for an unramified monomorphism of algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent conditions on a morphism of algebraic spaces: unramified and a monomorphism, unramified and universally injective, locally of finite type and a monomorphism, and universally injective with local finite type and formal unramifiedness; in this case the morphism is also representable, separated and locally quasi-finite. The proof compares the conditions through the characterisations of unramifiedness and universal injectivity, and derives the additional properties from them. Relating the monomorphism and universal-injectivity formulations through the earlier criteria is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2882-2903.
